title: The Forgotten Day
description: Because of a kidnapping case, an amnesia case, a missing woman and a big sum of money, waiter Ng Yiu-chung (Kwok Chun On) and interior designer Meng Yat-yin (Shaun Tam) bump into each other and develop a subtle friendship. After being saved, Yat-yin becomes an amnesia sufferer. He forgets the kidnapping. His wife Yau Fei-yi (Grace Wong), who has paid a ransom, is also missing. Yat-yin wants to rely on Yiu-chung to unravel the kidnapping case and also track down Fei-yi. But Yiu-chung wants to use Yat-yin for finding the vanished ransom. He also has to keep his involvement in the case secret. With psychotherapist Lam Hoi-ching's (Roxanne Tong) help, Yat-yin regains fragments of his memory. However, the surprising truth is steadily revealed as lost moments are gradually realigned.

title: Ai no onimotsu
description: Jozaburo Araki is the head of a famous family-owned wholesale pharmaceutical store with a well-established history. At present he is the Minister of Health and Welfare, and is considering submission of a Bill to hold population increase in check, in an attempt to easily deal with Opposition accusations regarding the population problem. However, just when he is in the Diet giving a major policy speech to the Welfare Ministry Committee about decreasing the population, Ranko, his 48-year-old wife, heads to a maternity clinic and discovers that she is pregnant. To make matters worse, he finds out that his eldest son, Jotaro, had been secretly having an affair with his own secretary, Saeko Godai, and it seems that she is also expecting a little 'Burden of Love.' Also, the Araki family's young daughter, Sakura, has become pregnant with her fiancé before their upcoming marriage, and even the retired patron of the family, Jozo, 2 presents yet another possibility of a pregnancy with his much younger mistress. Furthermore, Jozaburo visits Kyoto on an election campaign and is astounded to learn of the existence of his own love-child with his former lover, Some Kaida! As if that's not enough trouble, the Araki family finds that even their maid, Oteru, and their business manager, Yamaguchi, have somehow also ended up with their own 'Burden of Love.' And that is how the population explosion in the household of the Minister of Health and Welfare somehow becomes a factor in the future of Japan...

title: Shimanto-gawa
description: A young boy, Atsu, grows up along the banks of the Shimanto River in rural southern Shikoku. He comes to grips with the unfairness of life and the emotional pain involved in the loss of innocence.

title: Ng goh haak gwai dik siu nin
description: Tien-You has recently taken on a job as a security guard in an old mansion, and on the first night he takes his friends Nam and Priscilla along to keep him company. While exploring, they discover a mummy hidden away in the basement, which Tien-You accidentally breaks. The next day, Tien-You finds to his horror that his body is becoming dried out and transforming due to a curse from the mummy.

title: Requiem for a Massacre
description: Police investigators investigate the link between a serial killer's machinations and a young man who committed suicide under murky circumstances.

title: Ballad of a Worker
description: After WWII, an ex-soldier and his wife spend their lives working at modest jobs to raise their son and put him through school.

title: Angel's Mission
description: A female undercover detective from Japan goes to Hong Kong to investigate the disappearance of several young Japanese girls and finds that a drug ring is kidnaping and forcing young girls into prostitution.

title: Beginner's Luck
description: Lau and Chow are roommates and they both dream to strike it rich at the races. They invent a device that allows them to eavesdrop on jockeys in training for tips. When they lost at the races, Lau's girlfriend threatens to leave, and Chow is stalked by the loan sharks. Will they bet it all on one last race?

title: Family Feud
description: Two families compete by trying to outguess the opponents about survey results.

title: Liu lian wang fan
description: A radioactive plant threatens to turn a small town upside down - but a group of students take a stand. In the midst of the plant's construction, a teacher leads her students to battle against the building.

title: King Size
description: This comedy follows a young scientist in the contemporary world, who actually came from the world of dwarves, thanks to a magic potion, held by the Big Eater, ruler of the dwarves. The dwarf kingdom, Shuflandia, exists in a cellar of a library, and only the most obedient get the chance to grow to king size and inhabit the larger world. Once there, nobody wants to return to Shuflandia. Also, there are no women in Shuflandia.

title: Boss
description: This series revolves around a group of peculiar detectives in a new division created to fight against an increase in atrocious crimes. Osawa Eriko is a beautiful career woman who has just returned from training in the U.S. and is appointed as the "boss" of this division. But despite her intelligence and capabilities, she can never understand a man's heart, so she remains unable to find a husband. In fact, her assignment in the U.S. was really a demotion after she ruined her career track over a man. So why was she chosen as the boss of the new division? Even though the detectives are talented, they all have some kind of issue or flaw, and they are considered to be the "problem children" of the police force. In the end, the division's true purpose is just to isolate these problematic detectives.

title: Buy My Boss
description: Recent graduate Manfan faces bankruptcy, heartbreak, and misfortune. Seeking solace, she hires escort Araya, unaware her new boss Issara is the same person, leading to an unexpected revelation.

title: Air Boss
description: This week brings us to Millington, Tennesee, home to the Memphis Air Show, where one man bears the burden of responsibility more than anyone else - the man controlling the show... the Air Boss, Wayne Boggs. It's most definitely going to be a jam-packed day for Wayne who is bossing both day and night shows, and presents an exciting opportunity for hoards of fans anxiously awaiting to see the show headliner... "JET TRUCK." As one of the most action-packed and popular air show acts on the circuit today, the "Jet Truck" is driven by Chris Darnell, who is joined on the road by his family and the Jet Truck Mechanic, Wayne. Today the Air Boss faces back-to-back challenges with immediate delays putting him behind schedule and must do whatever it takes to bring his show in on time while everything that can go wrong does! Alongside the countless setbacks with staying on schedule, mechanical issues threaten performer Julie Clark's routine and may force her to cancel her biggest show of the season.

title: The Boss
description: A modest professor of philosophy plunges in spite of himself into the world of the underworld, when he goes to Paris, where he must attend a congress.

title: Pit Boss
description: Shorty Rossi, a dwarf, runs a pit bull rescue in the Greater Los Angeles area.

title: Builder Boss
description: Master contractor Jim Caruk takes on top custom home building and renovation projects. But each project comes with its own set of hardships and stresses, and Caruk and his team must overcome them all in order to get the job done.

title: My Boss Mom
description:
Sergio Lewin, the master of the Lewin Clan, asked his subordinate Calvin Guest to find his wife Jane Smith and daughter Tiara Lewin, who he had let down, and handed the clan over to his wife. He died before he could make public that Kasen Lewin was actually Jane's son.
Calvin Guest found Jane Smith and conveyed Sergio's last wish, but was rejected by Jane. So Calvin Guest had no choice but to disband the Lewin Clan. After Calvin left, Tom Hill, the village bully, came to bully Jane and forced Tiara to death, and the villagers helped him. At Tiara's funeral, Tom Hill humiliated Jane again. Jane could no longer bear it, so she called Calvin for help and agreed to become the master of the Lewin Clan.

title: First Class
description: Yoshinari Chinami, who has been selling buttons and fabric at a clothing material store in an old neighborhood of Tokyo, unexpectedly finds herself working at the editorial division of a fashion magazine and is thrilled. The fashion industry is a dazzling world which she has never seen before. But what opens up to her is a terrifying den of demons where females prey on each other day after day - - From the low-level person who has to do odd jobs for a lifetime to the uppermost level which manipulates magazines and advertisements at will, it is an industry of dramatic disparities. It is also a ridiculous female world where women assign ratings and rankings change everyday. The only way to survive in this harsh place is to be "first class". Chinami's only friend is the assistant photographer Nishihara Itsuki. Will she be able to to find happiness in this fashion hell?

title: Sigabo
description: Eight years after being imprisoned for a murder he did not commit, Gabo is unexpectedly granted parole. On his first day out, he boards a bus bound for home, only to find himself caught in the middle of a robbery orchestrated by his former group. As he fights to survive and protect innocent lives, his long-awaited freedom comes at a greater price—he is forced into a covert government program that recruits convicts for dangerous, high-stakes missions.

description: Six years ago, blindfolded Haley was bedded by Mafia boss Lester. Now ruined by her cheating husband Bill, she signs a healing marriage contract with Lester. title: Jackie goal maging recording artist this 2026
description:
Sa unang Sabado ng 2026, let's party kasama ang isa sa mga ipinagmamalaki nating "TNT" alums, Sofronio Vasquez. Nagpalit na ng kalendaryo, pero ang husay ni Sofronio ay hindi magbabago. Ano kaya ang tip niya sa mga aspiring singers? Ipinagmalaki rin niya ang kanyang bagong versions ng "My Way," na ang isa ay ka-collab pa si Michael Buble. 

Masaya ang salubong ng "It's Showtime" sa 2026 dahil sunod-sunod ang celebrations. There are more reasons to be happy dahil may nagdiriwang ng birthday sa Showtime family! Happy birthday sa nag-iisang Mr. Suave, Vhong Navarro! Simple lang naman ang birthday wish ni Vhong– good health para sa kanyang pamilya at nawa'y maging mas magaan ang bago at susunod pang mga taon para sa ABS-CBN. 

Upang swerte ay ma-manifest, kailangan may winner's mindset! Katulad ng mga Mandaluyong residents na nagsama-sama sa 'Laro Laro Pick', dapat happy para ma-attract ang positivity. 
Na-good vibes nga si Vice Ganda sa pagiging masayahin ni Buko, ang buko vendor na very much in love sa asawang si Rose. Lahat ng tao sa studio, natawa sa whirlwind romance ng dalawa, na nagsimula sa pagiging magkababata hanggang sa nagkaibigan na lang bigla. Going strong ang kanilang pagsasama na biniyayaan ng tatlong anak. 

Magulo pero masaya rin ang kuwentuhan with Nora. Kahit mga pusa lang ang kanyang kapiling, happy naman siya sa solo living. Sa dulo ng laro na bagong paborito ng nation, si Cathy ang sinuwerte sa PILImination. Call her strong independent woman, pero pagdating sa pilian ng Pot o Li-Pot, mas go na siya sa sigurado. Ang sure money na P30,000, kanyang tinaggap kapalit ng P150k Pot question, na tungkol sa character name ni Vice Ganda sa pelikulang "Call Me Mother."
Pagkatapos ng handaan sa Noche Buena at Media Noche, sa "TNT Duets 2" entablado naman naghanda ang mga duos na sumalang sa ika-anim na weekly finals.

Diva skills raised to the second power ang bitbit nina Pia Caduyac at Heaven Blanco, na bigay-todo sa pakanta ng "Mamma Knows Best" sa entablado. "Superb singing" kung ilarawan ni Punong Hurado Louie Ocampo ang duet, at "effortless" naman ang ginamit na salita na Jed Madela. Pinuri rin ni JM Yosures ang whistle harmony ng dalawa. 

From barrio to TNT entablado, ipinagmalaki nina Vensor Domasig at Jovany Satera ang pinagsamang husay nila, singing "Honey My Love (So Sweet)" na tamang-tama ang timpla ng blending. Magkaiba man ang opinyon ng mga hurados tungkol sa 'novelty' element ng performance, siguradong pare-pareho naman silang na-entertain. Payo lang ni hurado JM, itaas pa ang level of difficulty. 

Concert level din ang "Always Be My Baby" performance nina Nowi Alpuerto at Isay Olarte, bagama't nasobrahan si hurado JM sa unison, na kinontra naman ni Maestro Louie, na tinawag pang 'showdown duet' ang pagtatanghal.

Mula sa angkan ng mga mang-aawit, sanib-pwersa ang magpinsang sina Mark Justo at JR Oclarit. All-out ang husay nila sa pagkanta ng "All At Once." Komento ni hurado Jed, aprang umiiyak ang mga tinig ng dalawa. Kahapon ay muntik nang ma-gong ang magpinsan, pero ngayon ay bawing-bawi sabi ni hurado JM. 

Ang magical chemistry nina Eujan Arda at Hyacinth Granderos, parang idinuduyan ka sa langit. Bagay sa piyesa nilang "I'm Your Angel." Dama pa rin ang husay, sabi ni Maestro Louie, pero pakiramdam niya'y ingat na ingat ang dalawa sa pagkanta. 

Teka, sa husay ng mga weekly finalists, na-inspire si Jackie Gonzaga sa goal niyang maging recording artist this 2026. Payag ba si Ogie Alcasid na mag-collab silang dalawa? More collabs pa ang aabangan mula kina Mark at JR, at Nowi at Isay dahil duos nila ang aabante sa next round ng kompetisyon.

#ItsShowtimeNa 
#ShowtimeTahananKoTo 
#ItsShowtime

title: 2025 action
description:
He Came Out of Hiding for One Last Job | Unseen Enemy | Full 2025 Action Thriller - A private investigator is reluctantly persuaded to come out of hiding to help a friend find her missing sister.  Learning that not everything is as it seems, the clues lead him to a dangerous man that is working with the gang he was hiding his family from.  He’ll have to fight his way through them to save the woman and leave no one alive to ensure his family’s safety.

Unseen Enemy follows a private investigator who has gone into hiding to protect his family from a violent criminal gang. When a desperate friend begs for help finding her missing sister, he’s forced back into the life he swore he’d left behind. As the investigation deepens, he uncovers a web of lies that leads straight to a ruthless man tied to the very gang hunting him. Perfect for fans who love hard-hitting action thrillers, gritty crime stories, and revenge-driven survival films.

description: Taiwan built a "silicon shield" to protect itself from mainland Chinese attack by ensuring it became indispensable to the world as a key supplier of advanced microchips. title: The Boy I Hate
description: When her boyfriend suddenly drops out of their roadtrip to her best friend's wedding, Samantha Smiles is forced to take the long drive from LA to NYC with the boy she's spent the last five years trying to forget. The boy she spent one secret summer night with. The boy she let take ALL her firsts: Tristan Montgomery, AKA her best friend's older brother! Torn between loyalty and her resurfacing (mutual?) feelings for Tristan, Samantha has to make a choice: will she keep living for others, or will she finally, for once, do something for herself?!

title: Mafia Queen's Good Girl
description: Pearl is a good girl: three jobs, a dying mother, zero luck. Talia Voss is the opposite: a mafia queen with a bullet in her side and no use for love. One kiss on a train binds them—Pearl becomes her "good girl," collared, bought, forbidden to want more. But when rivals cage Pearl for auction, Talia learns the price of a good girl is a war. She pays it.

title: My Lucky Star
description: This is a romantic drama set against the backdrop of power, identity, and social justice. The story follows Akira, a brave village girl who enters a forced marriage with Lakshya, a billionaire who hides his identity as a poor caterer. While Akira joins the Vardhan Group to stop the demolition of her village’s livelihood, Lakshya secretly helps her while maintaining his disguise. Their relationship evolves from awkward strangers to partners who fight injustice together. The show explores themes of class divide, hidden identity, ambition, love, and rural empowerment. With humour, romance, and emotional confrontations, the narrative builds towards Akira proving that compassion and roots are more powerful than wealth.

title: Still a Family
description: In 2015, Tongzhou officially became the sub-center of Beijing, and the people were very happy. Sai Duoxi's family, who lived in the alley of the old wharf of the North Canal and were doing renovation, received the demolition payment as promised. The five brothers and sisters of the Sai family quarreled over the demolition payment. In the process, the hidden problems of each family were exposed one after another. Sai Duoxi was diagnosed with a terminal illness. Facing his children who were like a pile of scattered sand, he was always unable to treat them equally, and he fell into distress and reflection. His greatest wish was to see his children live in harmony before he died, and this hope could only be placed on his eldest daughter-in-law Wen Jiayin. Wen Jiayin, the eldest sister-in-law who was always gentle and docile but determined in her heart, began to clean up the "mess" of the Sai family in the name of her family. With her efforts and inspiration, the five brothers and sisters finally corrected their shortcomings according to their father's expectations, united, turned danger into safety, and realized their father's long-cherished wish of "family harmony brings prosperity".

title: Class 4 Hindi - All Chapters Rimjhim NCERT Book
description:
कक्षा 4 हिंदी प्लेलिस्ट में आपका स्वागत है! यह संकलित वीडियो कलेक्शन कक्षा 4 के छात्रों के हिंदी सीखने के मार्ग में मदद करने के लिए तैयार किया गया है। चाहे आप छात्र हों, शिक्षक हों या अपने बच्चे की सीखने को समर्थन करने वाले माता-पिता हों, यह प्लेलिस्ट आपकी मदद करने के लिए यहां है।

इस व्यापक प्लेलिस्ट में, आपको कक्षा 5 हिंदी पाठ्यक्रम के विभिन्न विषयों और अवधारणाओं को कवर करने वाले वीडियो देखने को मिलेंगे। प्रत्येक वीडियो को स्पष्ट और सरल तरीके से प्रस्तुत किया गया है, जिससे छात्र सामग्री को प्रभावी ढंग से समझ सकें।

प्लेलिस्ट पाठ्यक्रम के साथ मेल खाती है और मूलभूत अवधारणाओं से शुरू होकर धीरे-धीरे उन्नत विषयों की ओर बढ़ती है। वीडियो व्याकरण, शब्दावली, पठन समझ, लेखन कौशल और हिंदी साहित्य जैसे महत्वपूर्ण क्षेत्रों को कवर करते हैं |

title: Databases and SQL for Data Science with Python
description:
Working knowledge of SQL (or Structured Query Language) is a must for data professionals like Data Scientists, Data Analysts and Data Engineers. Much of the world's data resides in databases. SQL is a powerful language used for communicating with and extracting data from databases.
In this course you will learn SQL inside out- from the very basics of Select statements to
advanced concepts like JOINs. 
You will: 
-write foundational SQL statements like: SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, and DELETE 
-filter result sets, use WHERE, COUNT, DISTINCT, and LIMIT clauses 
-differentiate between DML & DDL 
-CREATE, ALTER, DROP and load tables 
-use string patterns and ranges; ORDER and GROUP result sets, and built-in database functions
-build sub-queries and query data from multiple tables 
-access databases as a data scientist using Jupyter notebooks with SQL and Python
-work with advanced concepts like Stored Procedures, Views, ACID Transactions, Inner & Outer JOINs through hands-on labs and projects
You will practice building SQL queries, work with real databases on the Cloud, and use real data science tools. 
In the final project you’ll analyze multiple real-world datasets to demonstrate your skills.

title: Desii Boy!!
description: When Munna Fashionwala, the flamboyant yet grounded heir of the legendary Tartari gaon, arrives at Mumbai Fashion Week dressed like a village eccentric, the elite fashion world ridicules him. But as one humiliation after another turns into shocking revelations, Munna is forced into a battle of identity, heritage, and cultural pride against influencers, fashion tycoons, and global experts to prove that true fashion is born from roots, not trends.

title: Guns & Gulab
description:
This story is a high-voltage romantic thriller set against the backdrop of crime, power, and emotional conflict. It explores the journey of Naina, an innocent yet resilient girl, whose life takes a drastic turn when she crosses paths with Kabir Ahuja—a ruthless mafia don who falls obsessively in love with her.
The narrative blends intense romance with action, betrayal, and family drama. At its core, it questions morality, power dynamics, and the meaning of love—whether love can be forced or must be earned.
With strong emotional stakes, dramatic twists, and a dominating male protagonist versus a morally grounded female lead, the story promises a gripping mix of passion, revenge, and transformation.

description:
Mafia Girl is a high-voltage romantic crime drama with dark humor and emotional depth.
Mayra, who rules the underworld with fear, experiences love for the first time—with a man who has nothing but honesty.
Sunny, always exploited and underestimated, finally becomes someone worth fighting for.

Every episode blends romance, danger, and drama with shocking twists.
At its heart, it asks—can love survive when it is born in violence?

title: Baki-Dou: The Invincible Samurai [Hindi]
description: Following his legendary father-son battle against Yujiro Hanma, Baki faces a new threat: the resurrection of Japan's greatest swordsman, Miyamoto Musashi. As warriors like Doppo Orochi, Jack Hanma, and Kaoru Hanayama return to the fight, the stage is set for an unprecedented clash the strongest underground fighter vs. the legendary samurai, in a cross-era showdown.

description: Enter the 24th Ward, a man-made island inside Tokyo Bay. Three of its inhabitants: Shuta, Ran, and Koki, have been best friends since childhood, but after a deadly incident, everything changed. A year later, reunited for the first time, they receive a mysterious phone call. On the other line is a familiar voice from a friend who's supposed to be dead. Together, they'll have to save their home.

title: A Day at a Time
description: Alba and Anastasia are twins with cerebral palsy who touched the heart of President Clinton with their plea for equal access. They come from an extraordinary family where everyone is determined the twins will be included in all activities. The fact that they are both in wheelchairs does not keep them from school, summer camp, or church. Their mother, Mary, thinks nothing of carrying them up and down several flights of stairs in their wheelchairs. She is a woman in constant motion, bathing, dressing, feeding and taking pleasure in seeing the twins are attractively dressed. She uses her tenacity and charm to assure that her children receive all the medical and educational benefits to which they are entitled. The filmmakers became close to the family, capturing the milestones of their lives: a birthday party, days at summer camp, their joyous first communion in church. Filmed over a period of four years, this unforgettable story will inspire everyone concerned with the challenges of family life and the place of disabled children in our society.

title: A Day in a Life
description: Paris. Gabrielle and Enzo, two teenagers from the same gang, meet in front of the school. Cigarettes, the affirmation of sexual desire and the discovery of new drugs punctuate their day. Each one, in his own way, celebrates or laments childhood that is slipping away.

Months later, the gym thrives. Kane and Eve find family and purpose together.

title: C-Suite TV Insights
description: C-SUITE TV INSIGHTS is a program that takes you inside the minds of the most respected visionaries, thought leaders and entrepreneurs in the world.

title: My Unicorn Girl [Hindi]
description: When she was eighteen, Sang Tian makes a wish to enter her mother's school to become part of the Chinese figure skating team. However, she did not pass the ranking test but somehow disguises as a guy and was accepted into the Ice Hockey team. Having no choice, she adopted a new identity. However, her plan was foiled by the sudden appearance of Wen Bing. Wen Bing and Sang Tian become room-mates. After one encounter, the two former "arch enemies" suddenly become good friends. The two of them decide to work together with their team mates and do their best in the championships. However, Sang Tian's secret was eventually exposed. Despite this, she still gets the chance to become a member of the first all-female Ice Hockey team. Sang Tian is finally able to become a real girl and continue chasing her dream.

title: Class C: The Only Game in Town
description: As their tiny hometowns fight to stay on the map, girls from across rural Montana compete for the state basketball title and a chance to bring home something worth celebrating. Montana native and basketball legend Phil Jackson brings insight and humor to the disappearing landscapes of his youth in a story that will change the way you see rural America.

title: Bureau 749
description: A traumatized young man with physical abnormalities is forced to join a mysterious bureau to confront a disaster spreading across the earth caused by an unknown creature. He embarks on an adventure uncovering mysteries about his life.

title: Wadd: The Life & Times of John C. Holmes
description: Friends, enemies, acquaintances, and family of porn star John Holmes recall their experiences with him, from his childhood to his eventual death from AIDS in 1988.

title: Against the sky Supreme [English]
description: The entire universe is divided into the inner universe and the outer universe. The two universes are enemies of each other. The outer universe is ruled by demons, and the inner universe is divided into The Realm of gods, the Eternal Realm, and the Mortal Realm. In the universe, there are countless mortal worlds like the Tianfa Continent, and they are collectively referred to as the Jiutian Xin Region. In the field of Jiutian Xin, nine immortal emperors commanded all star fields in nine layers. Above the nine heavens is the realm of purification of immortal gods.

title: E
description: E along with his friend Tony (Karunas) carries out small crimes to earn money. E brought up in tough conditions, grows up as a tough, fearless and emotionless guy. Meanwhile; Dr.Ramakrishnan (Ashish Vidyarthi) a quack comes to the slum and projects himself as a do-Good to people living there. Not knowing his ulterior motives, the slum dwellers keep unshakable faith on him. However, his hidden agenda is to make use of them as guinea pigs to test his new but potentially lethal medicines.E saves Dr.Ramakrishnan from Nellai Mani (Pasupathy), a terrorist, who is after the Doctor to kill him. Realizing E's boldness the Doctor enters into a pact with E to capture Mani in return for a huge sum. E captures Mani and when he takes him to handover him to the doctor. title: 30:e november
description: On November 30th (the date when King Karl XII died) there will usually be demonstrations by hyper-national and neo-Nazi groups, and also democratic counter demonstrations. The plot of "West Side Story" is transferred to the Stockholmian suburb Alby where many immigrants live. But the film is no plagiarism, in particular no so because many scenes have the intensive character of live transmission. The boy (Adam) belongs to a Nazi group whose racial attitude is foremost directed against immigrants with 'wrong' colour of hair or skin. The girl (Julia) belongs to a family of political fugitives from Peru. Adam and Julia immediately fall in great and reciprocal love, and there are highly emotional love scenes. Therefore Adam breaks with his group. But when his best friend is killed by Julia's brother, he kills the brother. In turn the couple is hunted by the police and Julia's relatives. Both Adam and Julia are finally murdered. The film takes no step toward reconciliation.

title: F--kland
description: Fabián, a magician from Buenos Aires, saves his money from weddings, birthdays, and bar mitzvahs, and uses a hidden camera to document a week-long trip to the Falkland Islands where he has a patriotic plan: to impregnate a British woman. If 500 Argies do this annually, the islands will soon be overrun with children belonging to both cultures. He spends his first couple of days in Stanley doing reconnaissance, setting his sights on Camila, whom he's first seen in church. He chats her up at an Internet café. They go out for drinks, then dinner, then to the see the King penguins and a 1982 battlefield. Back home, editing his Dogma 95 film, he receives a final message from Camila.

title: Legends of F1
description: The Legends of Formula 1 is a thrilling documentary that takes viewers on a high-octane journey through the history of one of the world's most prestigious motorsports. Featuring iconic drivers from different eras, it delves into the lives and careers of racing legends like Ayrton Senna, Michael Schumacher, Lewis Hamilton, and others who defined the sport. Through rare footage, interviews with drivers, teams, and experts, and behind-the-scenes stories, the documentary captures the drama, triumphs, and tragedies that shaped Formula 1, showcasing how these champions pushed the limits of speed and innovation to etch their names into motorsport history.

title: Killing John F. Kennedy
description: John F Kennedy was one of America's greatest presidents. He was the voice of the people who was a natural public speaker and a cool calm figure in front of the cameras. His influence helped push America through the most dangerous moments of the cold war, diffusing what could have been world nuclear destruction. But in November 1963, his life would come to a devastating end through the hands of an assassin. But who would kill one of the most popular presidents? Why was he a target? Join us as we investigate the life and career of JFK and ask the question...Who was really behind the killing of JFK?

title: Gimme an 'F'
description: Can a squad of misfit cheerleaders with an over-age trainer possibly win the big cheerleading competition? Looked down upon by the other teams, it will be difficult. Their lack of skill and talent make it even harder.

title: Mesquite Outlaws F.C. Game
description: The first game kicks off at 7:30am and the second at 10am. The 10am game will be broadcast on the Mesquite Outlaws Twitch channel. Be sure to tune in. all Games will be produced by Lou Productions, US, and broadcast over twitch. Check out Team and League Websites for schedule information. The Draft took place in the ballroom of the Statler Hotel in Dallas, Tex. on Sunday, October 23. Each of the League's 14 teams had an opportunity to scout talent at the Pro Player Combine held in Mesquite, Tex. over the three days prior. Players came from as far as France and Australia and as close as Dallas to showcase their talents and hopefully land a roster position on one of the League's teams. The draft consisted of three rounds with team's having a pick in each. Teams also had the opportunity to trade or sell their picks. "It feels great, it's everything I could have asked for, I worked hard to get here," said Gomez. "I'm grateful for the opportunity, all the coaches, the MASL and the Commissioner, who gave me a lot of tips and motivated me throughout the whole process."The day we've all been waiting for is finally here. The talent and intensity have picked up with every new game and today's contests should be an exceptional display. If the combine were a regular season today would be the championship game and the vibe in the hotel is fitting. The players were once again reshuffled into four rosters.

title: Christiane F.
description: A teen girl in 1970s Berlin becomes addicted to heroin. Everything in her life slowly begins to distort and disappear as she befriends a small crew of junkies and falls in love with a drug-abusing male prostitute.

title: H: Murmur
description: Serial killer Shin-Hyun gives himself up to police and confesses to committing a series of particularly horrifying murders of exclusively female victims. He is imprisoned and awaiting the death sentence but the killings continue, with the same characteristics of the Shin-Hyun serial killings. The case is re-opened when two more bodies are discovered, both pregnant women; one found in the city's landfill site and the other was horrifically murdered on a public bus. Detective Mi Yun (Yum Jung-Ah) and her newly-appointed partner Detective Kang (Ji Jin-Hee) are assigned to the case. Mi Yun and Kang have difficulty working with each other; their personalities and working methods constantly clash. Detective Kang goes about his new job buoyantly and enthusiastically. He follows a new suspect, Huh, and eventually catches him in the act of brutally murdering a woman in a crowded techno bar. Huh is taken into custody after Kang shoots and wounds him at the crime scene. Once again, the case seems to be solved with this spectacular arrest--yet the murders continue in copy-cat style. The police desperately hunt for new leads. They start an in-depth investigation of a Doctor Chu, who is Shin-Hyun's psychiatrist, but progress is frustrated when Dr Chu becomes a victim of the copy-cat killings herself. The murdered psychiatrist's former boyfriend, a fanatical character named Choi, quickly becomes the prime suspect. All the pieces are finally starting to fit together, and the case seems almost resolved. But all efforts are suddenly frustrated once again, when Choi takes his own life--but still, the killings continue. The case gets more complicated when even the police themselves appear to become suspects in the murders. In unraveling this mystery, everyone involved is pushed to the limits of human understanding.

title: I Razor
description: Told from the perspective of a former scientist turned wandering telepathic man-child, I Razor is the story of one man's quest to regain his lost humanity. Gregory Fleer, a young scientist who has developed a new brain-altering substance called I Razor, is transformed by his own experiment and must negotiate his way through a world twisted beyond recognition by his altered perceptions. The film begins with Dr. Fleer already transformed, and teamed with his equally afflicted companion The Professor, who possesses certain inexplicable magic powers. Together, the Sergeant and Professor experience visions, perform music, and take a dark journey through a world populated by a tribe of fellow "freaks" and their leader, the phantasmagoric Mother Skinny, along with her right hand subhuman creation, The Homunculus. When the Professor abandons the Sergeant, the Sergeant finds some solace in the natural world, but his yearning to reclaim what he believes to be his lost identity unwittingly draws him back into the fray of society, where a struggle between good and evil awaits him.

title: I Loved, I Hated, I'm Done
description: Valerie Jackman experiences a rebirth and wakes up at the age of 27 with two kids and a husband—Lucian Floyd, the world's richest man and every woman's dream. title: Put k prichalu
description: Young Vasya finds a job on the sea rescue tow Kola, where he befriends a bunch of colorful characters: sailors Bruno and Marat and constantly depressed bosun Zosima. Kola gets a task to retrieve Polotsk, a ship, abandoned during the war.

title: Wir Sind vom K u K Infanterie-Regiment
description: A Viennese architect opposes his girlfriend's ambitions as a cabaret singer and turns away from her to do his duty in the infantry and prepare for war.

title: The Penthouse: War in Life S1-S3
description: The story of a woman who strives to achieve her goal of entering high society by becoming the "queen" in the 100th floor penthouse in Gangnam, the pinnacle of success in her eyes.

title: Switch Case N
description: An IT guy has things going well for him in his career and relationship but things change for the worse when he switches between companies. He has to deal with the change and learns to live with it.

title: Class N Session
description: Casting "Class N Session," a new series. Synopsis: Meet Kaitlyn Johnson (Jassy Marie), an intelligent, teenage African American sophomore girl with a quick sarcastic wit to match, which fits her future aspiration of becoming a criminal lawyer, which stems from watching marathon episodes of "Law and Order" on cable with her mother. Kaitlyn's best friend since pre-K is Vanessa Hardison (Alexis Dees), who's also an intelligent African American sophomore girl who decided her own future aspiration of becoming a celebrity lawyer after watching old footage of Johnny Cochran's performance in the O. J. Simpson trial. She also has a similar sarcastic quick wit. For years, these girls used the same facial expression to communicate with each other when someone said something idiotic. Their favorite facial expression is named "The Garfield Look," which matches the bored facial expression of Garfield the Cat. Both young ladies attend Ladera Heights High School, along with their new friends, Lisa Kim (their eccentric but very smart friend), Caleb Stevens and Louis Taylor (two of the brightest class clowns you ever want to meet; think Romeo and Bullethead from "The Steve Harvey Show," with intelligence), and Cissy Bailey (their sassy Caucasian friend who was raised in the hood). This prestigious secondary school is run by Principal Bryant, a very thorough, no-nonsense principal who's fair but firm and also has an annoying tendency to pop up unannounced on her students anywhere. Principal Bryant doesn't tolerate disruptive students who waste their time in high school; she's especially strict on rules about the students not sassing their parents. Every high school student has a favorite teacher; Mr. Reevis is that favorite teacher, who uses wit to teach his U.S. Government class. With Kaitlyn and Vanessa's aspirations of becoming a criminal lawyer and celebrity lawyer, can they survive through all the trials and tribulations high school has in store for them? Watch "Class N Session" to find out.

title: Rock 'n Tokyo
description: Tokyo proposes several different levels of reality. You can find anything you can imagine there and at the same time get a new surprise at every corner. I chose to portray this amazing city through rock 'n roll music. The Japanese love and understand rock, a kind of music and a way of life they discovered during the American occupation, after World War II. Even if Japanese society still preaches uniformity and order, there is an important underground world, where people live more freely. This is the Tokyo I show in my movie. We follow 4 rock bands : Guitar Wolf, 3 good looking guys wearing black leather and sunglasses, a singer/guitar player with a devilish presence, a garage rock that is among the most intense and loudest ever heard and surprisingly- a contract with a big record company ; The 5678s, rock-a-billy queens with a wild 50s elegance who conquered the world with a memorable scene in Quentin Tarantino's Kill Bill ; the Jet Boys, led by an extreme, crazy, border-less and exhibitionist singer/guitar player ; Nine, young guys who believe in success by music - when I first met them, they played in front of Shinjuku station as if it was the last concert of their lives. The movie shows their music, but also their way of living, their style-totally faithful to rock ,n roll- and their wanderings all around the incredible city that is Tokyo.

title: Stories N' Steel
description: A fresh take on automotive reality TV, each episode features builders, collectors and craftsmen telling their stories through lively discussion and visual examples of their passions.

title: Pete 'n' Tillie
description: Tillie dreads another blind date with Pete Seltzer, who hides his insecurities behind jokes and flirting. Though initially resistant, she gradually warms to him as their relationship develops into marriage.

title: Romeo n' Juliet
description: Only one will survive. This is their story. William Shakespeare's immortal tragedy 'Romeo and Juliet' has remained vital through five centuries, and is now reborn and blooms in contemporary, post-Soviet Latvia. 25 years have already passed since Latvia regained its independence from the Soviet Union, yet it's facing urgent issues in the present day - two ethnic groups are living in separate communities, thus dividing one country in two. Shakespeare's play has never lost its urgency, proving its greatness in terms of genre and message. Now, "Romeo n' Juliet" depicts the contemporary love story of a young Latvian girl, Juliet, and a Russian guy, Romeo.

title: In 'n Out
description: A comical story of a scatter brained hero who is invited to his Pa's funeral. Never having known his father but still suspecting foul play, he travels to Mexico to learn the truth with hilarious results.

title: Chiquis 'n Control
description: Chiquis heads to New York City and confronts her shopping addiction only to return home to L.A. to face selling all her luxury goods to raise money for the salon.

title: Dom n° 8
description: The developmentally disabled children at Home No. 8 in Gorna Banya are rehearsing a musical-gymnastic number to celebrate June 1st, the International Day of the Child. The theme of the celebration is "Peace on Earth." During the course of their endless practice sessions, an obvious conflict arises between the their caregivers' rather absurd notions of peace and happiness and actual everyday life in the care home. By the end, one of the children has reached 18 years of age and in accordance with the rules must be moved to a new home: Home No. 6.

title: Vincent N Roxxy
description: A small town loner and a rebellious punk rocker unexpectedly fall in love as they are forced on the run and soon discover violence follows them everywhere.

description: Kesh a gifted scientist in the field of AI develops a program called Jack and Jill that can sharpen the physique and mental ability of a person in order to fulfill his father's wish

title: Down 'n Dirty
description: Dakota Smith, a hard-nosed but scrupulously honest cop, has more than a few questions when his partner is murdered.

title: Lock 'n' Load
description: A Vietnam vet has nightmares about murder and zombies, and then discovers that he and other vets have been programmed to commit crimes and then kill themselves afterwards so they can't be traced. He investigates to try to find out who is responsible.

title: Salle n° 8
description: In ward 8 of a Parisian hospital, patients come and go but the staff stay. There are Anne and Serge, the medical externs, Philippe, the resident, Madeleine, a nurse, Marc, the surgeon, Mamadou, the orderly, etc., shown in their daily life.

title: Suster N
description: A movie about the famous ghost of the Dutch raised nurse, Norah, who can not walk for having a wounded leg.

title: Rock 'N' Roll Ringo
description: A scaffolding builder loses his job and starts as a temporary worker at the funfair. There he is seduced by a showman into making a career as a fairground boxer - and hopes to fulfill a long-awaited dream for his daughter.

title: O
description: O is a dark comedy about necrophiliac vampires who run funeral parlors, collecting blood from corpses and processing it into red meth which they sell to their kind. The film dives deep into the vampire drug culture and the lengths that they're willing to go through for a fix.

title: O Capiau Contra o Diabo
description: A community in the Brazilian countryside has its order disturbed by the arrival of outsiders: a group of teenagers who find out, the hard way, that the Devil exists.

title: O Maria
description: Maria is a single woman of forty plus, living alone with her mother (Sulbha Arya), running a quiet business of putting up tourists in her house by the sea and a small restaurant. She has the good fortune of owning a land and a house in a prime spot by the sea which is eyed by developers. Philomena (Meenacshi Martins) needs to sell their ancestral property which is at a prime location to a Gujarati property developer Jiten Shah 'Jitubhai' (Tiku Talsania). For this, Philomena's elder son Jack (Aryan Khedekar) teams up with his mother to seek Maria's approval as her brother John (tiatrist Roseferns) has already signed an agreement to this effect. Mike (Cory Goldberg), an American staying as a guest with Maria, also gets dragged into the issue. Cory Goldberg had earlier played the role of a tourist in the Incredible India ad campaign.[1] Ruzar (tiatrist John D'Silva) plays the sacristan who gets the villages together.

title: O Sábio
description: Pedro, a man with special gifts, returns to his hometown after being missing for 20 years.

title: O Mineiro e o Queijo
description: Poetic and political account of the tradition handed down from generation to generation for over 200 years for the production of artisan cheese in the state of Minas Gerais, Brazil.

title: O Kadin
description: The love story of a model who is betrayed by her fiance and a doctor who saves her from depression.

title: O Cerco
description: Ana is surrounded. In the apartment below, the ghosts of the past and on the terrace, the ghosts of the future. But she resists.

title: O Klearhos, i Marina & o Kontos
O nyom
description: For the characters life prepares a tragic test - test of love, loyalty and honor. Each of them must make hard choices, sometimes sacrificing their lives for the happiness of their loved ones. Moscow. After the death of his wife, producer Dennis goes to find his adopted daughter 's father - a young priest, Alexis, who is said to live in the monastery. Alex, who took a vow of silence once, decided to break for the sake of his beloved daughter. Each of the characters in this film has to make difficult choice ...

title: O Sakaflias
description: 1935. Giorgos Sakaflias has the reputation of the toughest man of Trikala. He loves the beautiful but poor Lenio, while the rich Nora wants him. Nakas, who wants Lenio his own, will blame Sakaflias for the murder of Smyrnia's prostitute. Nora, too, when she does not succumb to her appetites, will blame him for rape. Sakaflias will leave from Trikala. The police will ring him and start looking for him.

title: Henry O!
description: Spanish-language color commentator for the Tampa Bay Devil Ray's Enrique "Henry" Oliu does the impossible - he calls a game he's never seen.

title: O retorno da luz - o início
description: In 1986, 21 unidentified flying objects were detected by the radars in Brasília and São Paulo, and 5 fighters took off to intercept them. A girl is born from this moment and, 10 years later, a second one, with different views of the world, ability to heal and move objects, and much superior intelligence, which can affect everything and everyone around her, bringing with them, the return of light.

title: O Liberdade
description: The documentary talk about a magic place, the heart of the bohemian in Pelotas, southern Brazil. The Samba, Choro, and all the popular culture.

title: O Donzelo
description: In the countryside, the virgin hick Nestor sees a naked model taking pictures and chases her through the fields and village. His father decides to pay for the services of the local prostitute Marli, but Nestor feels repulse for the whore and his father expels him from the village. Nestor travels by foot and hitchhiking and along his journey, he meets his cousin; the young prostitute Janete "Tutuquinha" in a brothel; the young Dulce that is participating of a scavenger hunt in her Fiat No. 18; the charming actress Leila; but their encounters do not meet his expectation and Nestor does not lose his virginity. When he arrives in Rio de Janeiro, he is arrested and in the jail he meets a travesty. When he is released, he finally fulfills his mission.

title: O Touro
description: A Portuguese girl arrives at the Lencois Island, in Brazil, curious about this new place surrounded by huge white sand dunes. Its residents are all descendants of King Don Sebastian, who disappeared in the 16th Century.

title: O-Negative
description: A doctor forces his daughter's boyfriend to help him find and kill unsuspecting victims in search of that one with O-Negative blood that will save the daughters life.

title: O Papa que Venceu o Comunismo
description: When a cardinal who had been considered harmless by the Soviet Union is elected Pope, he initiates a spiritual revolution that challenges and destabilizes communism, culminating in the fall of an empire.

title: O Guarani
description: The forbidden love affair between Peri, an Indian, and the beautiful Ceci, a Portuguese white girl, in the 17th century Brazil.

title: Brian O'
description: A plasterer writes a novel, something which he had never contemplated doing until one night his internal pain forced him to begin typing

title: O Grão
description: The elderly Perpétua, feeling the approach of death, decides to prepare Zeca, her beloved grandson, to the inevitable. She tells him the story of a king and a queen, a wealthy and powerful couple who lost their only child but wishes to bring him back to life. Meanwhile, Damião e Josefa work hard to support their family and to prepare their daughter Fátima's wedding. At the end, the tale told by Perpétua and the destiny of that family will cross.

title: O papatrehas
description: With six sisters on the verge of marriage, a desperate spinster aunt, and an entire block of flats depending on him, an indefatigable concierge is making plans for the future; however, he must first find suitable husbands for his siblings.

title: O Magnata
description: In São Paulo, the upper middle class punk-singer Andre a.k.a. Magnata spends his time in the periphery with his friends from the lower class, singing in clubs and wasting his inheritance. When he is challenged by his friends to steal a Ferrari from a store, he accepts the challenge and he goes with his pal Chivitz. They rob the car and after driving for fun, Magnata goes to the stage for a concert and asks Chivitz to get rid off the car because it would be located through the GPS system. However, Chivitz decides to drive more and is arrested by the police. Meanwhile, Magnata meets Adriana Melo, who has just arrived from New York, with his friend Renata that invites him for her birthday party on the next day. Magnata dates Adriana and falls in love for her, but this reckless prank stealing the Ferrari leads them to a tragic consequence.

title: O anakatosouras
description: A string of bizarrely improbable coincidences upset the balance in the orderly life of a meek employee, as the sudden appearance of a self-confident doppelgänger leads his family to false assumptions. But, who is this mysterious "other"?

title: O... Çocuklari
description: Turkey is under the yoke of the military regime. Unbelievable events will develop in the axis of the house of the custodian mother, who takes care of the children of prostitutes.

title: O Fascínio
description: O FASCÍNIO is an intriguing story about a family and a manor house (where some terrible crimes were committed in the past by a member of that family) adapted from a novel with the same title by Tabajara Ruas.

title: P.S. I Love You [Hindi]
description: A young widow discovers that her late husband has left her 10 messages intended to help ease her pain and start a new life.

title: S. P. Parasuram
description: A strict Police officer tries to go after criminals but ends up as the bodyguard of a minister whom he had jailed in the past for being a rowdy sheeter.

title: Pipo en de p-p-Parelridder
description: Pipo the Clown receives a letter from his aunt. She tells him the castle which lies nearby her house, is haunted. Pipo leaves the circus to visit the castle. Things aren't what they seem and a race against time begins.

title: It's Showtime
description:
Dedma sa ex na kumakatok at may pasalubong na paulit-ulit na pasakit. But, hello sa grupong nagbabalik sa "It's Showtime" entablado para pagandahin ang araw n'yo. Napaindak ang buong nation sa performance at taas ng energy ng P-Pop group VXON.

Dazzling sa pagrampa sina Miss Q and A Resbakulawan candidates Andrea Jane Peralta, Jers Sabado, at Mama Dhel. Dahil Resbakulawan, diretso nang sumalang ang tatlo sa Wit Lang. Pagkatapos, sina Andrea at Jers ang umabante sa BEKLAMATION.

Na-impress si hurado Nicole Cordoves, pero aminadong nakulangan nang kaunti sa 'chukchak' ng dalawang ladies. Kaya para iwas-bitin, pati si Vice Ganda ay tumalak na rin! Sa huli, itinanghal na Miss Q and A Reyna Talak-Era Resbakulawan daily winner si Andrea.

Hindi na kailangan pang tumama sa lotto para masabing lucky sa araw na 'to! Dahil swerte agad ang lumapit sa mga taga-San Isidro, Cainta Rizal na bumida sa Laro Laro Pick game arena sa "It's Showtime."

Walang mapapagod kakatawa sa mga challenges sa game arena. Sa paboritong Act-Song portion sa You Gotta Lyric round, time-out muna sa kilig scenes sina Brent Manalo at Jackie Gonzaga dahil magkapatid muna sila sa isang eksena ng family drama.

Hindi naman horror story ang pagsali ni player Pao. Dahil matapos ma-eliminate, nabunot ang pangalan niya upang maglaro sa jackpot round dahil bigo ang mga naunang players na ma-secure ang spot.

Ramdam ni Vice Ganda ang matinding pangangailangan ni Pao, isang siomai vendor na nag-iipon para sa kanyang operasyon sa mata dahil sa kondisyon na keratoconus. Ramdam din nito ang puso ng manlalaro. Kaya para bang binigyan niya ito ng lakas ng loob na sugalan ang POT question.

Pigil ang hininga ng Madlang People at lahat ng nasa studio, hanggang sa isinigaw ni Pao ang sagot. Bumuhos ang emosyon at saya nang i-anunsyo ni Vice Ganda na tama ang sagot ni Pao at maiuuwi nito ang P350,000 POT money.

title: Ang bilis naman! Papu, 'dumamoves' kay Nelds
description:
Minsan, life imitates fiction, 'ika nga. Ang mga eksenang akala mo sa pelikula lang nakikita, pwede rin palang mangyari in real life. Kung nakaranas ka na ng mala-romcom scene sa totoong buhay, eh di ikaw na, siguradong makaka-relate ka sa bagong harana ng P-Pop group VXON. Bukod sa kuwento tungkol sa kanilang bagong awitin, may bitbit din silang pa-kilig sa mga fans as they celebrate their 4th anniversary!

Hindi pa man nagsisimula ang games sa Laro laro Pick, ang mga lola't lolo na players, muntik nang magbardagulan sa pag-aagawan ng puwesto. Vice Ganda to the rescue!

Nakuha naman ni Nelds ang atensyon ng mga tao sa studio dahil sa mga kuwento niyang walang preno. At ano itong chika na nagkayayaan na sila ni Papu na mag-date? Sa kanilang kulitan, may nasabi si Nelds na tiyak iyong ikagugulantang, kaya si Meme, napahingi na lang ng paumanhin sa MTRCB.

Laugh trip din ang mga eksena nang si Vice Ganda'y mamalikmata. Napagkamalan si Papu na isang personalidad na umano'y "nagtatago," o para ring "roll on na nagpapawis." Kinilala rin nila si Beth, na nagtuturo sa mga batang may ADHD. Teka, nanggigil si Meme! Bakit kasi ang dami niyang kapareho ng OOTD?!

But the luckiest of them all ay si Loi! Mahirap man ang buhay, positibo pa rin ang panananaw ni nanay. And with that positivity, tama lang na sugalan ang POT question baka sakaling masungkit nag P200k POT money.

Sa pagbubukas ng panibagong yugto sa Ika-10 Taon ng 'Tawag Ng Tanghalan,' matutunghayan naman natin ang talento ng mga taga-Region 5.

Hinarana ni Isaiah ang Madlang People sa studio, singing "Binibini" by Zack Tabudlo. Nabilangan man ng "isa" ni hurado Jonathan Manalo, hindi siya nawalan ng confidence sa entablado.

Ang 18-year-old contender na si Paulene, mahusay mag-majorette. Pero ang panalo sa TNT, hindi niya na-get! Na-gong ang mang-aawit sa hudyat ni Punong Hurado Bituin Escalante, na naniniwalang na-pressure ang kalahok na pretty. Sabi nga ni hurado Jonathan, "do not second-guess yourself."

Relate si Darren Espanto sa rejection na na-experience ni Paulene, kaya napa-reminisce siya about his "The Voice Kids" era, at in-encourage si Paulene na sumubok muli.

title: The Remarkable Tale of Phineas P. Gage
Jhong at Sarina, sanib-pwersa sa pag-SAMPLE
description:
Bugtong-bugtong, may korona ang hari, may kandila ang cake. Birthday ng Sample King kaya ang buong "It's Showtime" stage ay na-shake. Kasama ang unica hija na si Sarina, ipinagdiwang ni Jhong Hilario ang kaarawan niya.

Bago magsimula ang Miss Q and A segment, it's time para sa inaabangan din na kumustahan at chikahan ng trio nina Vhong Navarro, Vice Ganda, at Jhong Hilario. Mula sa puksaan ng kasuotan hanggang sa asaran ng edad, lahat na 'ata napag-usapan ng magkakaibigan.

Samantala, mga dalubhasa sa pagtalak sina Miss Q&A candidates Dhey Pascual Abital, Beshie, at Erwina Tirambulo. Kung sa nakaraang episode ay nagpakilala ang mga kandidata at hosts with their love status, ngayon naman ay pabonggahan sila ng intro borrowing the acronyms of executive agencies sa Pilipinas.

DOJ, as in Diretso ang Opinyon, Jaw-dropping ang perfromances ng mga kandidata sa pagsagot sa pageant questions. Sina Dhey at Beshie ang umabante sa Wit Lang round.

Bumoses si Dhey tungkol sa pagbabayad ng buwis at epekto ng korapsyon as she answered the question, "Kung kinain ka na ng sistema, may nakuha ba silang sustansya?" It's better to give than to receive naman ang talak ni Beshie sa tanong na, "Kung binabalot ka ng kalungkutan pwede ka bang iregalo?"

Hindi 'to kuwentong barbero. Totoong nag-enjoy sa Laro Laro Pick ang mga masisipag na barberong swabe ang dating. Time out muna sa paggamit ng gunting, sa pagsayaw at pagsagot muna nila ipapakita ang galing.

Enjoy ang hosts sa kuwentuhan kay Jun, ang loving hubby at daddy, na pangarap mapagpatapos ang anak sa kolehiyo. Dahil sa pangarap ni Jun, nakaramdamn ng lungkot si Vice Ganda. Naisip niyang sa Pilipinas, itinuturing na "pangarap" ang diploma, pero kung tutuusin ito ay "basic need na dapat naibibigay sa lahat ng mga bata.

Give na give ang players sa mga challenges sa game arena, hanggang sa may isang natira, si John. May pabaon na swerte ang kanyang buntis na misis. Nakapag-uwi si John ng P40,000 matapos tanggapin ang offer. Nanghinayang nga lang si John dahil alam niya ang sagot sa POT question. Kaya dinagdagan ni Vice ng P10,000 ang papremyo ng barbero.

title: Miss Q&A Nadimunyo Lustre
description:
Positive lang ang vibes sa August 11 episode ng "It's Showtime" dahil birthday ng nag-iisang Sample King, Jhong Hilario. At ang wish niya ay hindi lang para sa sarili kundi for everybody. Eyyy!

As colorful as the rainbow rin ang kilig na bumuhos sa studio dahil sa performance ng isa sa mga paborito nating musical duos—JM Dela Cerna at Marielle Montellano, na may bagong anthem perfect para sa mga naghahanap ng lambing, titled "Perfect Together."

Kung ito ay isang color palette, bright ang bawat shade na hatid ng Miss Q and A candidates. Meet Heaven Jumawan, na head-turner ang beauty. Comedy naman ang forte ng comedy bar performer na si Senyora Acero Kabakal. Ibang 'amats' din ang baon ni Nadimunyo Lustre, na asset ang out-of-this-world na mga ngiti.

Maya-maya pa, nagsimula na ang unang round, Tumpak Ganern, kung saan unang nakasagot si Heaven. At ang nakalaban ni Heaven sa Wit Lang? Eh, 'di si Nadimunyo!

Pinalakpakan ang talak ni Heaven sa tanong na, "Sino ang mas gusto mong nag-a-update sayo—jowa mo o NDRRMC?" Pero panggulat ang naging chukchak ni Nadimunyo sa tanong na, "Anong pipiliin mo—otsenta anyos ka na pero wala kang jowa, o may jowang otsenta anyos?"

Ang mga players of the day sa Laro Laro Pick, sanay sa industriya ng hospitality. Maging warm din kaya ang welcome sa kanila ng swerte? Makilaro muna kasama ang mga receptionists ng Makati.

Panalo agad sa tawanan ang kuwentuhan nina Vice Ganda at player Chinn, ang receptionist ng Glowingly Yours salon. Nataranta naman si Neo dahil sa hotel na kanyang pinagtatrabahuan, may dumating na dalawang artista. Ano ang ggawin niya kapag nag-check in sina Ogie Alcasid at Vice Ganda?

Pagkataos ng tatlong rounds ng masayang laro, si Rovie ang umabot hanggang dulo. Hindi na pinahaba pa ni Vice Ganda ang tawaran, dahil desidido si Rovie—kahit anong mangyari, POT ay kanyang susugalan!

title: Miss Q&A
description:
Loud ang cheers at concert feels sa June 16 episode ng "It's Showtime," as Ryan Bang performed some of the best OPM hits sa isang masayang birthdayprod, na nagpaindak sa mga manonood.

Araw-araw ay parang grand celebration ng mga 'beki' na hatid ay good vibes. Sa Day 2 ng pinakabagong season ng "Miss Q and A," muling umulan ng tawanan kasama ang sangkabaklaan.

Nagpasiklaban sina Contestant 1 Michelle Calamity, Contestant 2 Kelly Agustin, at Contestant 3 Linda Walker. Kung si Vice Ganda ang kahulma ni Michelle, si Jhong Hilario naman daw ang kamukha ni Contestant 2. At kung fairytale ang kuwento for today’s video, si Kelly ang prinsesang napapaligiran ng wicked stepsisters.

Sa unang round, ligwak si Contestant 1, pero pangako niya, she will return better and fiercer than ever. Sa pabonggahan naman ng wit sa ikalawang round, full of confidence ang pagsagot ni Linda, at pak na pak ang opinyon ni Kelly. Proving that she's got both beauty and brains, nasungkit ni Kelly ang bilib ng judges na sina Karylle, Ralph de Leon at Nicole Cordoves. Si Kelly ang itinanghal na Reyna Talak-Era of the day!

Palaki nang palaki ang papremyo sa game arena, kaya naman ganado sa Laro Laro Pick ang mga senior citizens ng Tandang Sora.

Agaw-eksena ang rakistang si Bro, na um-skip muna sa isang mahalagang pag-uwi sa probinsya para makapaglaro sa studio. Si Vice Ganda naman ang maintenance nina Lola Nene at Edith dahil makita lang siya, sapat na para sumaya!

Dahil ginalingan at kinapitan ang swerte, sa jackpot round, si Tatay Roger ang umabante. Pagpapataya ng 'ending' ang kanyang pinagkakakitaan. Katulad ng hanapbuhay ni tatay, kailangan sumugal para makuha ang jackpot money na P200,000.

Siguradong may isang lolo na happy dahil si tatay Roger ay may maiuuwing P30k, matapos tanggapin ang Li-Pot offer.

title: Miss Q and A
description:
Here to brighten your day, bumisita si Iñigo Pascual para haranahin tayo sa kanta niyang "Ikaw At Ikaw." Ikaw na, Iñigo! Ikaw na ang kakasa sa "Oooh Lala Baby" dance challenge!

Ang mga Miss Q and A ladies, nag-transform from kandidata to comedians real quick! Nagharapan sa talakan sina Iya Zaga Arkanghel ng Laguna, Miss Mia ng Bulacan, at Toni Fowler ng Cavite.

Pinalakpakan ang kanilang galawan at confidence sa rampahan. Ang ‘amats’ nilang tatlo, hindi kayang itago! Pati si Vice Ganda ay naloka sa sagot ng mga kandidata. Kelan pa nging ‘fishda’ ang ingles ng bangus? Nawindang din si Meme sa dilim ng kili-kili ni Toni! Maya-maya pa, sina Iya at Miss Mia ang umabante sa Round 2. Sino ang mas aangat sa talakan?

Salamat sa kanilang sipag, napapanatiling malinis ang ating paligid. Kaya naman deserve nila ang bumida sa 'Laro Laro Pick game arena. Sila ang mga madlang utility workers.

Sa kuwento ni Berto, parang may nag-awoo! Bilang utility worker sa isang ospital, sanay na siya sa mga paramdam, hindi ng ex na nang-ghost, kundi ng mga kakaibang 'nilalang' na paikot-ikot, patakbo-takbo sa ospital na kanyang pinagtatrabahuan.

Kung tumaas ang 'yong balahibo sa kwento ni Berto, tataas naman panigurado ang level of happiness mo sa magulong aktingan sa 'You Gotta Lyric' round. Parang pelikula na kumpleto ang casting, sanib-pwersa sa pag-Act-Song ang paborito nating quadro—Vice Ganda, Anne Curtis, Vhong Navarro at Jhong Hilario.

Ang mommy of walo na si Riz ang umabante sa final stage ng laro. Swerte nga ba ang numerong otso? Nag-goodbye si Nanay Riz sa Li-Pot offer na P35,000, para sugalan ang P25,000 POT question.

title: she Q
description: A story about a man who is skeptical of being alive and explores absurdity. He is informed that he had a daughter ,who died recently. He accepts his existence by thinking about her life.

title: Barbie Bratz Ayuda nag-WALK OUT sa Miss Q&A?!
description:
Nagbabalik to birit si ‘Tawag Ng Tanghalan’ champion Lyka Estrella, na tanghaling tapat pa lang ay kasintaas na ng sikat ng araw ang boses. Move, give way dahil ready na to slay sina Lucky Collins, Barbie Bratz Ayuda, at Eysi Vigo sa Resbakulawan wildcard round ng Miss and A.

Dahil Resbakulawan, diretso nang sumalang ang tatlo sa Wit Lang round kung saan nasubok agad ang kanilag talino at creativity. Ang Top 2 na sina Lucky at Barbie ay muling nag-face off sa Beklamation kung saan nasubok ang kanilang talak sa tanong na, "Okay lang ba sa'yo kapag jinowa ng best friend mo ang ex mo?" Magkaiba ang saloobin nina Lucky at Barbie, ngunit parehong may punto.

Sa dulo, si Barbie ang mas nanlamon sa entablado at wagi sa unang Resbakulawan, matapos makakuha ng score na 9.7 mula kina Max Collins, Ralph de Leon, at Yllana Aduana.

Heto pa ang isang pagbabalik. Ang kinagiliwan noon na 'Showtime' kid na si Yorme, napadaan to celebrate his birthday habang nanonood ng It's Showtime. At kahit saglit lang nasilayan, instant throwback feels at good vibes ang hatid niya sa sambayanan.

Samantala, kapag may emergency, sila ang umaaksyon at nagbubuwis ng buhay. Ngayong Lunes, energy nila ay rumaragasa sa game arena. Sila ag mga Madlang Rescuers na bumida sa Laro Laro Pick.

Pagkatapos ng mga eksenang nakakakiliti sa Act-Song round na You Gotta Lyric, si Chie lang ang naka-survive kaya siya ang umabante sa jackpot round kung saan matapang niyang sinugalan ang P300,000 POT question na, "Anong pangalan ng galaxy ang kinabibilangan ng ating solar system?" Ang tamang sagot ay Milky Way!

title: Vice, nawindang sa Miss Q&A! Nanawagan sa DepEd!
description:
Salubungin ang July with champion biritan kasama nina TNT Duets 2 champs Christian Tbayan at Arvery Lagoring. Nagkaisa naman ang mga 'accla' sa Miss Q and A segment. Ang kanilang chika, bawasan ang problema at dagdagan ang saya. Ipinanalo nina Pia Cayetatayno, Mama Dhel, at Samaya Jhay ang protesta kontra bad vibes.

Isa-isang inilatag ng mga kandidata ang mga paandar nilang intro, drawing laughter from the Madlang People in the studio. Si Vice Ganda, may napansin sa tatlong kandidata. Kung si Pia ay may mga matang ala Meryll Soriano, si Mama Dhel naman daw ay mukhang 'baby' na 36 years overdue.

Nang magsimula ang unang round, ang nasabi na lang ni Meme ay, "Diyos ko!" dahil sa sagot ng mga kandidata for today's video. Sa tanong na, "Ano ang plural ng salitang furniture?" sumagot ang isang kandidata, na para bang sure na sure, "Super furnitures."

Kaya si Meme, 'nanginig' at nag-react nang pabiro, "Nananawagan talaga kami sa Department of Education. Gumalaw na tayo."

Sina Mama Dhel at Samaya Jhay ang nagharap sa ikalawang round, Wit Lang. Ang pinusuan ng mga hurado ay si Mama Dhel bilang Miss Q and A Reyna TalakEra sa araw na 'to.

Pumuti man ang kanilang buhok, nananatili namang makulay ang sense of humor ng mga beloved lolo't lola from Meycauayan, Bulacan na nakisaya sa Laro Laro Pick game arena.

Mga 'veterans' as in veterans sa pagpapatawa naman ang nagsama-sama sa You Gotta Lyric round na bagong inaabangan ng "It's Showtime" fans. Madlang People ay napa-wow nang si Vice Ganda ay lumabas bilang MemeRimar! Aww!

Ang happy ending sa kuwentong 'to ay para kay Tatay Philip, na umabante sa dulo ng laro. Positive lang ang pananaw ni tatay sa buhay. Aniya, pumunta siya sa "It's Showtime" nang walang dala, kaya aalis siyang sapat na ang P30,000 na Li-Pot offer.

#JulyNaShowtime
#ItsShowtimeFullEpisode 
#ABSCBNEntertainment

title: Come on in, We're Dead
description: The true story of the The Young Brothers Massacre, 1932. The record for the most lawmen shot dead in the history of the United States. 10 cops and one civilian in Springfield, Missouri went to arrest 2 small-time gangsters known as The Young Brothers. The young men (Harry, 25 and Jennings, 30) had been on the run for the murder of a town marshall 3 years earlier. The Sheriff, Marcell Hendrix, had been neighbors with the fugitive?s family and late father in particular, so he didn't expect any trouble. As a consequence, they showed up at the family farm with nothing but the six-guns on their belts, and little to no additional ammo, In spite of the fact that the boys were well known for their marksmanship. The farm was on a large open piece of land with a scattering of trees around the farmhouse. When the Sheriff and his deputy pushed in the door, a massacre ensued, The officers would become trapped behind those trees, as the brothers systematically picked off the officers from the cover of the dark farmhouse.

title: Ziggy: Soreyuke! R&R Band [English]
description: Japanese rock band Ziggy comes to London and gets attacked upon arrival at the hotel after a recording session. The musicians barely escape the attack; however, soon they learn that their producer has been murdered, and they are the suspects. Chased by police and some mysterious organization, they find shelter at a local rockers' place and even give a performance there; but it is not too long before their pursuers appear again.

title: R U There
description: R U THERE is the story of Jitze (20), a professional gamer who travels around the world to compete in video game tournaments. During a stay in Taipei he unexpectedly witnesses an accident, which confronts him with his own mortality and makes him doubt the certainties of his existence. When he meets a Taiwanese betelnut girl he is attracted to, he only manages to get close to her in Second Life, which serves to compound his doubts.

title: Walad w Bent
description: A romance full of emotions, adventure and humor, the love of a lifetime is what the film is about. But between this boy and girl the story is not that simple. Although their bond is unbreakable they keep separating over the years. It's not circumstantial forces or even external pressures, but the very individuality of each is what keeps getting in the way in spite of all the love that's cherished within. In tracking their early zigzagged path the film delves into the complex and intricate web of inner conflicts that arise between young men and women of this age and ultimately innovatively poses the eternal question: Can Adam and Eve live happily ever after ?

La joven logra fugarse con un botín de diamantes y escapar de México con la ayuda de un antiguo amante.

Al enterarse de que Luisa estaba embarazada, Sabrina la calumnió. Afortunadamente, la verdad sale a la luz. Sabrina fue ejecutada. Los enamorados se casaron.

title: María y yo

Sometimes Miguel and María go on holiday together, spending a week at a resort in southern Gran Canaria, a rather unusual setting where the guests don't normally include a single father and his fourteen year-old autistic daughter. This is the story of one of their journeys, but above all it's an original tale, full of humor, irony and sincerity, about how to live with a disability.

The music of the city of Bogotá at the time, accompanies their adventure and the visual noise of Chapinero becomes their peculiar background.

title: World 1-1
description: World 1-1 is the first in a documentary series on the history of video games. This chapter is about Atari and how they created a new industry. It focuses on the business deals, the personalities of the pioneers, and the creations of the engineers. This documentary will be a combination of interviews, archival footage, and reflection that retells the story to a new generation that may not know the roots of their favorite hobby. World 1-1 will follow the early games before the arcade machine even existed. It will tell the story of how Atari created the games industry years before it should have happened and follow the lucky deals and unfortunate mistakes that almost destroyed the entire industry just as quickly as it was born. Atari was the fastest growing company in the United States at the time. It kickstarted Steve Jobs' career, as well as others. The world's first successful arcade machine was built there, along with the first popular home console. Atari and its engineers formed the games industry we know today. It's time to tell this story, from the words of the creators themselves.

title: 5Gang: Un Altfel de Craciun
description: The story is about friendship and family which makes it an easy-to-watch, feel-good movie. With a Christmas theme, the movie is a story told by grandpa Selly (Romania's most well known vlogger) at the age of 74 and to his granddaughter. Before going to bed the granddaughter asks grandpa Selly to tell her a story from the times the trees were still green, because in 2075 global warming has stricken. Grandpa Selly talks about the environment and how we were supposed to take care of our planet more. In his story we go back to 2019 when 5GANG were about to break-up because of financial problems. Selly, trying to earn more money for the band, accepts a mobster's invitation to go to his daughter's birthday and then gets kidnapped. Pain and Madalin are going through a romantic drama and Gami wants a new gang.

title: Yes! Pretty Cure 5 S1-S5
description: Nozomi Yumehara, an ordinary middle school student, finds a magical device called the Dream Collet in the school's library and meets Coco, a creature from the world of Palmier Kingdom. Nozomi decides to help restore his world which has been destroyed by an evil organization known as Nightmare by collecting the 55 Pinkies in the Dream Collet, which is able to make any wish come true. By making the decision to help Coco, she proves she has the heart to be a legendary warrior Pretty Cure and is given a Pinky Catch. The Pinky Catch lets her transform into Cure Dream. However, Nozomi cannot fight the Nightmares alone; she must choose a team of four other students to become Pretty Cure along with her. Together with Cure Rouge, Cure Lemonade, Cure Mint, and Cure Aqua, they become Pretty Cure 5.

title: 6 Idiotet
description: A beautiful journey at first sight but not at all that usual. A group of youngsters from a suburban club of Tirana take a trip by an old van to celebrate a friend's birthday. Meanwhile the Police Department is investigating on a serial killer who is terrorizing the country with his mysterious murders without having a clue. The killer may be everywhere. Two directions that crush into a stolen innocent lamp by the serial killer sons will change the 6 Idiots route, bringing comical situations, filled with suspense, action, cynical irony, cultural sarcasm and black humor. Coming as a one-day-diary story of six characters, six alternatives, or to describe them best: 6 IDIOTS. If you would find yourself in their hands... you'd wish you never did. description: Eakam a philosophical fiction thinly based on the life of Shiva. This type of genre is never been attempted in Telugu. It's has been shot at a record span directed by a debutant B Varun Vamsi under the banner Ananda Thoughts production company and A Kalyan Sastry's Samskruthi Productions. Though there were certain limitations we roped in a young team and shot in various different locations in and around Hyderabad. The undercurrent of the film is a spat on the current stereotypical society. It's a new age drama which follows the five elements of nature viz. Earth fire wind water and sky.
